scope: Seven actual operator-driver deductions and same-noise/application closure; actual scoped adoption requires root reading every check/finding/input limitation

reported_checks.claim: The prescribed nonzero quotient H_W is separable and infinite-dimensional and has a real orthonormal basis of compact smooth representatives whose W-evaluations are independent standard real Gaussians.

H_{j,R}(t,x)=zeta_R(x) int_{u>0}|t-u|^{-a}(Gamma*f_j)(u,x-u term) is smooth real, spatially supported in B_{2R} with bounded mixed derivatives, satisfies the literal covariance row E[W_C(zeta_R F)g_j]=int H_{j,R}F, and depends only on the H_W class on t>=0.

A_j(I)=int_I S(-t)B(H_{j,R}(t))S(t)dt has gain E_r->E_{r+1}, E_s-adjoint gain E_{2s-r-1}->E_{2s-r}, hence both E_{s-gamma}->E; with chi=1 on B_{2R+T+1}, D_chi A_j(I)=A_j(I)=A_j(I)D_chi; and E[g_j ell_R(I;z,w)]=<A_j(I)z,w>_E.
For 0<=T_N<=B with positive compact B in S_m (m>=1) and T_N->0 weakly, ||T_N||->0 and Tr T_N^m->0.
For finitely many compact Z_l with V_out,V_in in S_{q/2} and independent standard real g_l, E||sum g_l Z_l||_{S_q}^q <= (q-1)^(q/2)(Tr V_out^(q/2)+Tr V_in^(q/2))/2.

X_N(t)=X_N((0,t)) converges in L^p(Omega;C^theta([0,T];B(E))) for all finite p>=1 in a separable closed path span, limit starts at zero and has compact values at all times on one event, and for large even q_0 the C^theta L^q norm is <= C sqrt(q) uniformly over even q>=q_0 and the basis.

There is a same-noise compact operator path M_R with finite-path convergence E:driver-path-convergence in every L^p C^theta B(E); centered Gaussian, starts at zero, compact at all times on one event; fixed Schwartz raw rows equal ell_R((0,t);z,w) in L^2 including long-interval additivity; basis indistinguishability; (E||M_R||^p)^(1/p)<=C sqrt(p) and exponential square-integrability; complexification and fixed admissible even Schatten indices.
The real compact-test quotient basis and physical post-convolution mask reproduce the literal original-W covariance row, using the actual E_s adjoint and no H_W-valued Gaussian.
Gain one and its dual index both produce E_{s-gamma}->E maps, and full two-entry forward/backward propagation gives both cutoff identities for the actual coefficient integrals.

Current 088/091 use the actual Fourier/Bessel columns, both compact summable envelopes, the retained Gaussian average and vanishing traces to prove same-space tail Cauchy convergence, row/additivity and fixed-interval compact Gaussianity.

Fixed-grid-then-mesh convergence and deterministic/probability interpolation produce a strongly measurable separable-span C^theta path, compact at all times on one event, preserving every fixed raw row and basis indistinguishability.

Per-p even-q selection yields C sqrt(p) and square-exponential integrability with constants independent of p and the noise basis at fixed R,T, and source-transfer 095 consumes the exact path/row contracts consistently.

Finite controls and index/constant checks recomputed: admissible tuples, q(p) selection, n=16 variance example, l2 moving projection, 2x2 Gaussian matrix test, cone/support checks, C1=0 and h=0/Gamma=0 definitions.

reported_limitations: This verdict covers only the bounded same-noise operator-driver chain (PROOF085,086,087,089,090,092,093) and its stated application closure plus the finite checks; it does not assign or rely on whole214, source-image, manuscript-render, Kimi, or final fresh cold-review clearance.

Named local inputs (061-084 and current 088/091) are used as supplied proved local statements; their exact types and hypotheses were checked at the points of use, but they were not independently re-derived from first principles.

Downstream source-convergence PROOF094 and PROOF095 were inspected only to confirm that PROOF095 consumes the path/row contracts produced by PROOF093; the whole downstream convergence module and later variational modules were not independently re-proved in this report.
The fixed-author 64-page manuscript is treated as edition/model/noise context, not as a premise of the driver deductions; no external book or all214 paper argument is re-derived.

All estimates are at fixed finite R,T with the strict parameter guards (gamma<min(1/2,(2-alpha)/2), q0 gamma>d, beta-eta-1/q0>0, alpha+a<2); no uniform growing-R path-norm estimate, critical Schatten endpoint q gamma=d, or Schatten-valued Holder path is asserted.
Gamma=0 sets the driver and all raw forms to zero directly; empty intervals are zero objects without evaluating B_alpha(0).
